title: Stop Saying "Very Busy"! 4 Better Ways to Say It #shorts
description:
Don't say "very busy". Say one of these instead:
• Swamped: I'm swamped!
• Hectic: I had a hectic morning.
• Snowed under: I'm snowed under with homework.
• The idiom: I'm up to my ears in work!

Full lesson: Stop Saying "Very" in English: 30 Words to Use Instead of "Very" (With Pictures)
